text:
matt: Heads-up: I'm sketching a migration to collapse numeric metric_id + tenant into a single metric_key (text) to avoid collisions and simplify dashboard joins. Need a quick sanity check before I write the runbook.

anya: quick Q — is this to fix collisions only or are we also trying to change how quotas aggregate?

matt: primarily collisions + smaller index footprint for console queries. Also makes routing -> analytics join simpler for the UI. Plan (high level):
1) add metric_key nullable text + concurrent index
2) dual-write metric_key from ingest service for 2 weeks behind a flag
3) shadow-read console using metric_key for some dashboards (canary)
4) backfill old rows in small chunks with throttling
5) switch reads and deprecate metric_id after 90 days

kevin: sounds fine but watch p99 of the dashboard queries. Adding a text index could hurt writes. Need chunked backfill + vacuum plan.

sara: also add telemetry/quality evals. If aggregations shift by >1% we should auto-rollback. Add an eval prompt set for top-10 customers.

matt: noted. SQL sketch for backfill (will tighten in PR):
```sql
ALTER TABLE analytics.route_metrics ADD COLUMN metric_key text;
-- set metric_key from existing fields in small batches
UPDATE analytics.route_metrics SET metric_key = tenant_id || '|' || metric_id::text WHERE metric_key IS NULL LIMIT 50000;
-- create index concurrently
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_route_metrics_metric_key ON analytics.route_metrics (metric_key);
```

nisha: API compatibility: please ensure the ingest API accepts both metric_id and metric_key for 3 months and logs a deprecation warning. We shouldn't force all clients to deploy at once.

kevin: +1. Also add a table size monitor and a throttle circuit on the backfill job. If write lag or bloat > threshold, pause.

matt: plan to run backfill as a stateful job that checkpoints. We'll chunk by created_at and sleep between batches. I'll add a dashboard for backfill progress and table bloat.

sara: telemetry hooks: add a regression alert for these metrics: dashboard_total_tokens, route_p50_latency, console_query_p99. If any move >1.5% during canary, abort.

ingest-bot: migration checklist created: https://internal.redwood/ops/migrations/1799997770-metric-key-coercion - includes dualwrite checklist, canary dashboards, backfill playbook.

anya: thanks. Can we target a small canary on Wed? If canary looks good + alerts green, schedule full backfill weekend. @matt please open the migration PR + run a dry-run backfill on staging. :thumbsup:

matt: will do. I'll post the PR link and dry-run logs once ready.
